question: The 'International Day of the Unborn Child' is observed every year on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 March**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On March 25, the Banquet of the Incarnation, the International Day of the Unborn Child, is marked.
 
• The day Remembrance for Abortion Victims was established in Uruguay in 1999 during St. John Paul II’s Coronation. 
 
• In 1993, El Salvador became the first country in the world to recognize a “Day of the Freedom to Be Conceived” as an official national holiday.
